name: necessary_register_rung1
purpose: Rung 1 of the constructed-substrate staircase (Codex round 26): replay and freeze the audit-adopted rung-0 consumers (seeds 11/23/37), then train ONLY a source writer (64-d source embedding -> 1-layer GRU(128) -> biasless linear -> unit vector replacing the <REG> embedding) with the answer-label + EOS cross-entropy through the frozen consumer. No code regression, no cosine loss, no state classifier. Zero configured filler between <WRITE> and <REG>. Arms on held-out permutations: own (s_e = e mod 8), 7 counterfactual values, shuffled donor source (state-changing derangement within matched panel/template/permutation), masked value, zero, fixed random, oracle code, zero-hook identity. Code-space telemetry is diagnostic only. Not a language-understanding or native-mathematics result: the unique value token makes this a proximal supervised symbol writer.
